author: reek
body: A particle fountain: particles spout from a source at the bottom, arc under gravity, and respawn when they fall off screen. One GPU thread per particle reads its (px, py, vx, vy) from the input buffer, integrates with gravity, and writes the output buffer; the host ping-pongs the two and draws speed-coloured additive points. Reference site's "CPU particle system" as a compute fountain. Integer fixed point (position in pixels, velocity in 1/16 pixel).
